name: Object-Centric Voxelization for Dynamic Scenes
aliases: Unsupervised Learning for Dynamic Scenes through Object-Centric Voxelization
definition: An unsupervised 3D dynamic scene decomposition method that unifies geometric structures and object-centric learning within a differentiable volume rendering framework. It solves the multi-view mismatch of 2D object segmentation and enables 3D-consistent scene understanding, novel view synthesis, and direct scene editing.
summary: DynaVol is an unsupervised method that decomposes dynamic scenes into object-centric 4D voxels to ensure 3D consistency and enable novel view synthesis without geometric priors.
